input_source: IFS operational analysis, GDEX d113001 ec.oper.an
model: TianXing model_extra, native 6-hour step, frozen weights

objective.field: Mean 850 and 700 hPa relative vorticity, each level Gaussian-smoothed with 100 km standard deviation
objective.operation: Spherical wind derivatives followed by linear Gaussian convolution; no hard cyclone center or argmin in loss
objective.spatial_window: Fixed ATCF center at each valid time; area-weighted Gaussian standard deviation 500 km, cutoff 1500 km
objective.time_weight: Equal mean over all 28 six-hour targets; initialization excluded
objective.terrain: Fixed verification ERA5T surface-pressure masks for both forecast and target derivatives; only locations with >=0.8 above-ground smoothed coverage at both levels enter the loss
objective.MSLP: Retained as a diagnostic, excluded from the primary late-Saudel objective because pressure and circulation centers separate inland

constraint.energy: Moist total perturbation energy, humidity coefficient Lv^2/(cp Tr), humidity weight 1; fixed global area and background layer masses
constraint.pointwise_bound: Absolute increment <= 3 times same-initialization ERA5 EDA standard deviation, per variable/level/gridpoint
constraint.regridding: Bilinear variance from 0.5 to 0.25 degrees, periodic longitude, then square root
constraint.control: Full TianXing 73-channel physical state; below-ground pressure-level controls frozen; RH lower bound preserves any existing negative background but permits no new negative-RH increment
constraint.background: Fixed original IFS analysis; never replace by an optimized iterate
constraint.energy_interpretation: Expected one-spread perturbation energy under the ERA5 EDA variance proxy; not a calibrated IFS probability region
constraint.shared_specific_humidity: Also enforce absolute physical q increment <= 3 EDA q spread and archived IFS q plus increment >= 0; jointly contract temperature and RH in violating cells

acceptance: Every candidate must satisfy wet energy and gridpoint bounds and lower the actual post-projection seven-day objective
interpretation: Retrospective constrained initial-state correction, not an operational forecast. Baseline/optimized track skill and cross-model transfer require their own rollouts.
